subject: a fox assembled from continuous curled wood veneer
pose: head tilted above a sweeping curled tail
art_direction: 薄雪松木带弯出狐形半身，尾巴卷成大弧，钴蓝染色边缘与暖木纹形成机敏神态。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a fox from a single curling strip of cedar veneer, using bends rather than carved solid anatomy. The strip forms two pointed ears, a narrow muzzle, and a broad tail loop that supports the head. Stain only the thin cut edges cobalt blue, leaving the wood faces warm and visibly grained. One tiny dark inset marks the eye, giving the fox an alert, slightly wry expression. Tilt the head above the tail curve and keep the silhouette compact. Use a pale oatmeal background with soft directional light revealing veneer thickness and small fiber irregularities. Center the sculpture at about seventy-five percent of the square, with the ears and tail fully inside the circular crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
